app.title: HHC — Human Hunter Check
app.subtitle: Self-triage whether a job/headhunting approach is a recruitment attempt
app.intro: Tick the warning signs you noticed in a suspicious job or scout approach, and HHC shows a risk band and a recommended action.
app.disclaimer: This tool makes no accusations. It does not label anyone a "spy" or decide guilt/innocence. The output is only a risk band (low/medium/high) and advice on what to do. Layer-1 runs entirely on your device and sends nothing.

f.heading: Sanctions / watchlist match (human-confirmed)
f.confirmF1: I have confirmed this designation-list match as a human (adds F1 and forces the 'high' band)
f.f1Pending: Candidate: needs human identity confirmation (not scored until confirmed)
f.f3Note: Weak match: shown for reference only, never added to the score

interpret.heading: AI interpret (optional)
interpret.intro: Paste the DM / scout message / screenshots you received and the AI will suggest likely indicators. You make the final call.
interpret.consentBody: Pasted content is sent to the Anthropic API via your local backend. It is not persisted on the server. Redacting the other party's name and face is recommended.
interpret.consentCheck: I consent to the above and want to send
interpret.textareaPlaceholder: Paste the DM / email / job text here (paste screenshots into this box too)
interpret.pasteHint: You can paste screenshots directly into the box (up to 8)
interpret.noKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set; §6 is unavailable (configure .env).
interpret.aiTag: AI suggestions (for reference) — you confirm by ticking the boxes
interpret.suggestedBandHint: AI's rough band: {{band}} (reference only; the deterministic engine sets the real score)

osint.heading: OSINT lookup (optional, public sources only)
osint.intro: Give a company / domain / name / title and HHC corroborates from public, lawful sources — including whether the affiliated employer/university/research institute matches a designation list. It never asserts identity or nationality.
osint.publicOnly: Public, lawful sources only (no LinkedIn scraping)
osint.watchlistNote: Candidates only. Nothing scores until a human confirms identity. Transliteration / same-name hits are weak (F3).

history.heading: Case history (encrypted, personal)
history.privacy: Stored encrypted on your device. Not for accusing or sharing about third parties. Nationality/ethnicity are never stored.
history.themePlaceholder: Probed theme (optional, e.g. semiconductor export controls)
history.savedFirst: Saved (1st time for this subject; total {{count}}).
history.coordinated: Possible coordinated targeting: {{n}} distinct actors probed the same theme ({{theme}}) in a short window.
